scripts.title: Doodle Catching And Rebattler Autofarm
scripts.features:
Features:
    Autofarms:
    - Default: Searches for doodles with the provided specifications.
    - Rebattler Farm: Automatically fights the highest level rebattler you can fight.
    Autofarm Options:
    - Build Chain: Automatically kill doodles that are of the same species as the one you selected, but don't match the other requirements.
    - Auto Heal Doodles: Heals and removes status effects from your doodles before each battle
    - Try to Catch Matches: Automatically uses your capsules in an attempt to catch doodles that match your specifications (Best capsules are used first) (Polkadot > Stripes > Basic)
    - Auto Buy Capsules: Checks how many capsules you have when you inject, and refills your capsules to that amount before each battle. (Refills polkadot capsules aswell)
    - Don't Stop Catching: Makes it so the autofarm doesn't stop after catching a matching doodle. (Only matters if try to catch matches is on)
    - Only Farm in Current Spot: Skips searching for encounters of your selected doodle and teleporting to their encounter spot, and instead farms whatever you're standing on. (Must be on a spot where you can encounter doodles)
    - Fast Forward: Makes encounters blazing fast.
    - Fight Cooldown: The amount of time to wait after a battle before starting a new one. I'd suggest setting this to 2, and if it breaks the autofarm for you just leave it at 3. (Turn this up if the autofarm is getting stuck on a black screen)
    Catch Options:
    - Set the minimum amount of stars matching doodles should have
    - Toggle only catching misprinted doodles
    - Toggle only catching multi-tinted doodles (These are super rare, I suggest keeping this off unless you're specifically looking for them and nothing else)
    - Set what doodle you want the script to catch (truly revolutionary)
    - The option to set what tint you want
    - The option to set what trait you want
    - The option to set what skin you want

Notes:
    - The doodle autofarm gets roughly 60 chain in 10 minutes for common doodles.
    - The rebattler autofarm will make 6k in 1 minute if you fight rebattler riley with a doodle that can one shot him
    - Without "Only Farm in Current Spot" on, the script will automatically search for, teleport to, and farm the correct encounter spot.
    - If the doodle does not have an encounter spot. The script cannot farm for it. (A place to find it in the wild)
    - If you select a doodle with a high evolution (that doesn't spawn in the wild) the script will find encounters for lower evolutions of that doodle.
    - If you select a mythic as the doodle you want to catch, the script will automatically turn on "Only Farm in Current Spot". You're responsible for finding where they spawn (even though it's usually anywhere)
    - if you pick the "Any" option for tint, trait, or skin, it forgoes the check entirely. ("Any" skin means any skin, and no skin as well)

Change Log:

08-29-2022
    - The script now has an option for "No Base Skins", which is like the any skin option, but it doesn't include no skin.
09-03-2022
    - Squashed various bugs
09-12-2022
    - Updated stationary mode to recognize more encounter spots. (Like the water in crystal caves)
09-13-2022
    - Added the Fast Forward toggle, which makes battles WAY faster
09-14-2022
    - Added a rebattler farm
    - The script will now automatically deny prompts to learn new moves
    - The script will now automatically accept prompts to evolve your doodle
    - Improved fast forward related lag
    - Added a "Don't Stop Catching" toggle, which makes it so when you catch a doodle (assuming you have catch matching doodles on), it won't turn the autofarm off
    - Added a fight cooldown slider. (This is the wait time after a battle ends before starting another one. The autofarm breaks for some people when this is at 2 seconds, so it defaults to 3 seconds but you can change it if you want)
    - Added a dropdown for tinted options (Let's you specify if you want a specific tint, only doodles that don't have no tint, or if you don't care)
    - Added a toggle for only catching multi-tinted doodles (multi-tinted doodles are SUPER rare, only enable this if you're ready for a long grind)
09-16-2022
    - Added the ability to choose what rebattler you want to fight
    - Made it so if you're fighting rebattler riley, and the first doodle in your party is level 30+, fast forward will go much faster (this is because the longer the game is sped up, the more the game builds lag)
    - Fixed switching to doodles of a lower evolution if there's no encounters for the selected doodle.
    - Added a notification that tells you how much you've earned from rebattler fights when you disable the rebattler farm

with all that out of the way, enjoy!

scripts.title: Team changer
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bloxss/Roblox-scripts/main/uwuware%20lib%20ui", true))()

local team = {}
local Path = game.Teams
for i, v in pairs(Path:GetChildren()) do
table.insert(team, v.Name)
end

local Window = Library:CreateWindow("GUi")

Window:AddList({text = 'Team Changer', values = team, callback = function(re) game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ChangeTeamEvent:FireServer(re) end})

Library:Init()
